responsibility: This definition module introduces the opaque DynamicStrings.String type and the main dynamic-string API used pervasively across GNU Modula-2 libraries. It owns construction, destruction, concatenation, slicing, copying, comparison, case conversion, whitespace/comment trimming, C-string export, and optional allocation-debugging operations such as PushAllocation and PopAllocationExemption, making it the central managed-string abstraction above raw ARRAY OF CHAR and ADDRESS interfaces.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface half of DynamicStrings: it exposes the opaque String type and public procedures, but hides the internal chained-block representation, cached C-string state, garbage tracking, and allocation-debug machinery implemented in DynamicStrings.mod.
